storage.temporary_examples: var projects are disposable tests, never the sole real project copy

query_rules: Project selection resolves a stored baseline, never an arbitrary source path.
Source bytes are rehashed and parsed by the existing DOCX reader.
Catalog metadata does not create a read receipt.
Response, task and receipt persist in one transaction before delivery.
Current reads refuse if the current baseline moves before receipt commit.
Explicit historical reads retain their original baseline binding.
Cursors bind the project baseline in addition to existing source, method and selector dependencies.
Saved response recovery returns the original response, even when the current baseline has advanced.
Physical-page queries require an explicitly selected persisted render bundle with independent reviewed mapping.
evidence_rules: Binding, check and disposition records carry actor_id and a surface field naming the driving local surface (browser, mcp or cli); manuscript captures name the surface inside the retained confirmation reason.
Only source_observation evidence is generated by this slice.
Evidence references immutable artifact versions, object locators, content and method hashes.
Evidence freshness is derived from actual source and method dependencies, not only baseline identity.
Import and parsing do not create semantic or scientific PASS.
Unreviewed observations remain NOT_REVIEWED, independently of CURRENT or STALE applicability.
Old baselines, evidence and read responses remain queryable and are not overwritten.
limits: Operator labels are not authenticated identity and this is not an MCP or desktop approval channel.
Author decisions are limited to explicitly confirmed DOCUMENT and PROJECT records; they do not override evidence or publish a scientific PASS.
Journal rule bindings and baseline request binding of decision versions are not accepted by this slice.
Page evidence registration preserves historical process and reviewer metadata; it does not attest them anew.
No manuscript editing, artifact deletion, retention cleanup, automatic cache or Agent orchestration is implemented.
Path checks do not promise isolation from a hostile concurrent process.
